title: A Garden for the Harbor
author: C. M. Yarrow
blurb: Juniper Underhill, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
